entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: A nomadic red-white-black clan of Tarkir that admires the dragons' speed, living by raiding and lightning magic.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the five clans (or dragon broods in the current timeline), whose Mardu live on the Sandsteppe.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A lightning-breathing dragon, brood leader of the Mardu lands, who becomes increasingly brutal and is eventually defeated by the Mardu rebellion.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: A transgender human woman and Mardu khan who, in the current timeline, follows Kolaghan as an equal.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Khan of the Mardu in the original timeline who leads the rebellion against Kolaghan in the current timeline and becomes Khan again.

entities.name: Ilagra
entities.description: The founder of the Mardu clan and its first khan.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose saving of Ugin from death diverged the timelines in 3279 AR.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker saved from death by Sarkhan Vol, creating the current timeline.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A figure who saw the Mardu as necessary because they killed dragons that would grow into threats.

entities.name: Tersa
entities.description: The creator of the ceremony later known as the Lightning Proving.

entities.name: Paala
entities.description: A general whose dalkovan holds a competitive Lightning Proving.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Kolaghan's brood made up much of the frontline and suffered heavy losses.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The ritual after which Zurgo became Khan again.

entities.name: Edicts of Ilagra
entities.description: The original Mardu warrior's code inscribed on dragon-hide scrolls, lost to time.

entities.name: Decree of Thunder
entities.description: The new Mardu code created after Kolaghan fell, with three primary tenets.

entities.name: Dalkovan Assembly
entities.description: The council of appointed generals that supports the Mardu khan.

entities.name: Lightning Proving
entities.description: The coming-of-age ceremony where aspiring Mardu capture lightning during a dragonstorm.

entities.name: Clash of Sky and Ember
entities.description: The primary Mardu religion, based on the Emberheart and the Skybreath in perpetual conflict.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol saves Ugin from death, diverging the current timeline from the original in 3279 AR.
events.quote: diverging from the original one in 3279 AR by Sarkhan Vol saving Ugin from death

events.summary: Alesha attends a meeting of khans that ends disastrously as the dragons attack.
events.quote: Alesha attempted to save her clan by attending a meeting with the other khans, only for it to end disastrously as the dragons attacked

events.summary: Alesha learns Kolaghan does not want to lead or enslave the Mardu, and she and her warriors follow the dragon as equals.
events.quote: was not interested in leading or enslaving the Mardu

events.summary: Kolaghan and her brood claim leadership over the Mardu by force, creating a new clan.
events.quote: She and her brood claimed leadership over the Mardu by force

events.summary: Under the dragons' leadership the Mardu become increasingly barbaric.
events.quote: Under the leadership of the dragons, the Mardu became increasingly barbaric, forsaking what honor they had possessed before.

events.summary: Kolaghan's brood fights on the frontline in the New Phyrexian Invasion and suffers heavy losses, driving out the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Though they ultimately drove the Phyrexian invaders out

events.summary: Rebel leaders raise the Mardu banner and begin open war against Kolaghan.
events.quote: Several rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and started the open war against Kolaghan

events.summary: The rebellion grows into a formidable army and defeats Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords.
events.quote: ultimately allowing the Mardu to defeat Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords

events.summary: After Kolaghan falls, a new code is created and the council swears allegiance to the new khan.
events.quote: a new code was created after Kolaghan fell, and the council swore allegiance to the new khan

events.summary: Zurgo leads the rebellion against Kolaghan and becomes Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual.
events.quote: In the current timeline, he led the Mardu rebellion against Kolaghan and became Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual .
